title: Broncos sign Taylor Rapp to their practice squad and will elevate him and RB Cody Schrader for the game vs. the Panthers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos sign Taylor Rapp to their practice squad and will elevate him and RB Cody Schrader for the game vs. the Panthers
sources.description: It was announced on Friday that the Broncos have released veteran safety Taylor Rapp. However, that was just a procedural move, as Rapp re-signed to the team’s practice squad today. The team also announced that they are elevating Taylor Rapp, as well as reserve running back Cody Schrader, to the game-day roster for Sunday’s game […]
